gconf = SimpleNamespace(get=lambda k, check_type=None: conf.get(k))

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)

        f.write('x')

sha = 'd' * 40
cached = os.path.join(tmp, 'c.bin')
